summary.text: Jeff Gonzalez is a Republican member of the California State Assembly from District 36 who took office on December 2, 2024, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists him as a U.S. Marine Corps veteran whose career experience includes working as a small business owner and pastor.

paragraphs.text: Gonzalez ran for California State Assembly District 56 in 2018, advancing from the June primary but losing the general election to incumbent Eduardo Garcia.
In 2024 he defeated Joey Acuña Jr. in the general election for Assembly District 36.
In the June 2, 2026 primary he finished first with 44.6 percent of the vote and advanced to the general election against Democrat Ida Obeso-Martinez.
For 2025 and 2026 he was vice chair of the Military and Veterans Affairs Committee and the Water, Parks, and Wildlife Committee, and a member of committees including Agriculture and Higher Education.
